endorsements.quote: This includes clear documentation of the model's logic, limitations, and the provenance of training data, even if synthetic.
They advocate for real-time bias monitoring and corrective mechanisms to prevent harm to vulnerable populations.

unlisted_practices: Establish sector-specific standards and generation quality benchmarks for synthetic data used in health care.
Disclose synthetic data output as synthetic so it is not treated as real data.
Validate and test synthetic data generation models carefully before use.
Develop third-party auditing and certification mechanisms to verify that synthetic datasets meet ethical and legal standards.
Document synthetic data generation processes transparently and include mechanisms to assess and correct bias.
Ensure traceability of the data lifecycle from synthetic generation to AI integration.
Do not bypass ethical review for synthetic data use simply because it lacks direct identifiers.
Audit profiling systems trained on synthetic data for discriminatory assumptions, especially for pediatric populations.

screen.reason: This paper presents a legal and ethical framework/commentary for governing synthetic data generation and profiling in healthcare under EU law.
